entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • WarningsNotAsErrors does not prevent NU1605 from becoming an error #55709
  • Sometimes a long delay is observed after aspnet by `dotnetup` as it sets up the `env` in codespaces #55708
  • dotnetup creates ~/.bash_profile that shadows ~/.profile, silently breaking login-shell PATH #55700
  • Warn when TargetFrameworks declares a single framework: it evaluates every such project twice #55699
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#7) #55696
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-wire-contract-constants: drift detected (#0) #55695
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-wire-contract-fieldids: drift detected (#0) #55694

Closed

  • When installing or updating workloads, better handle flaky network connectivity #20617
    Backlog
  • Repair causes fatal exception when you add the metadata file for MSI to a applocal file based installation #20096
    Backlog
  • Allow VB import definitions to be overriden / removed from an app #19697
    Backlog
  • Colons in `#:property` names should be disallowed #55670
    11.0-rc1
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With .NET 11.0.100-rc.1.26404.101, dnx/dotnet tool exec failed with "Unhandled exception: The type initializer for 'Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.TransactionalAction' threw an exception." #55603
  • Add MsDeploySkipRule support for web package deployment #12477

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0.4xx] Update XML transform for apphost.exe #55707
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Update XML transform for apphost.exe #55706
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • Re-enable template search sorting test #55705
  • Install .NET 5 runtime in the SDK build environment #55703
  • Support file-based apps in MTP dotnet test #55701
  • Use GitHub app for pushing to the VMR during synchronization #55698
    Servicing-consider
  • Place file-based app artifacts into repo's artifacts dir if used #55697
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Flow CodeAnalysis analyzers version automatically #55680
  • Update XML transform for apphost.exe #55704
  • Document dotnetup for internal previews #55683
  • Fix preview workload version search #55685
  • Update Windows SDK projections #55444
  • Show modified `shell` in `dotnetup` to explain modes #55648
    Area-dotnetup
  • Address deadlock and race conditions in WebSocketConnection #55651
  • Onboard the Build Failure Analysis agentic workflow #55539
  • Disallow `:` in property directives #55671
    Area-run-file

Updated

  • Prototype outline for `dotnetup` self update mechanism #55511
  • Route vendored-sync drift issues to area triage via manifest-declared labels #55520
  • Migrate test package feeds to dotnet-public #55463
  • Add NuGet source/restore options to `dotnet workload search version` #55681
  • Fix workload advertising manifest extraction with WiX v4+ built MSIs #55576
  • Fix invalid argument handling for workload search version #55682
  • Support solution filter (`.slnf`) inputs in `dotnet workload restore` #55599
  • Resolve analyzers from the analyzers group in project.assets.json #54646
  • Add more tests for `CA2007` rule for `await using` and `await foreach` cases #55542
  • [Experiment] Create a .NET SDK Issue Monster #55243
  • Avoid TFM resolution during workload discovery #55677
  • Add `dotnet pack --no-default-excludes` #55669
  • Skip redundant container uploads for existing manifests #55690
    Area-Containers
  • File-level directives: allow quoting and additional properties #55592
    Area-run-file
  • Make published container images reproducible #55689
    Area-Containers
  • Add SolutionX item template for creating an empty slnx file #55638
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55688
